message.content: Based on the discussions between LiHua and ThaneChambers, it appears that LiHua finds the exploration aspect of Black Myth: Wukong particularly immersive. Specifically, LiHua mentions, "The exploration aspect is also a lot of fun for me, finding new areas and secrets." This indicates that the game's open-world elements and ability to discover new locations contribute significantly to LiHua's enjoyment of the game.
